title: Ginuwine is 56 and still undefeated: live at Lehman Center, Bronx
caption_reel:
Ginuwine is 56 and still undefeated 🐎

30 years after Pony, the Bronx showed up for one night only at @lehmancenter: Ginuwine with special guest Ro James. It was our co-founder Wally's first concert ever, and as 80s babies who grew up on this era of R&B, this one hit home.

@ginuwine, thank you for the night. Thank you to Leah Grammatica, Alexa Downing and the whole Lehman Center team for having the Den. 🎥 @wstudiosnj @mr_a_plus

What's your #1 Ginuwine song? 👇

caption_facebook:
Thirty years after "Pony," Ginuwine played one night only at Lehman Center for the Performing Arts in the Bronx, with special guest Ro James, and the Bronx showed up dressed for it.

It was also the first concert ever for Osvaldo "Wally" Rodriguez, co-founder and producer of The Innovators Den. As 80s babies who grew up on this era of R&B, we felt every minute of it.

Thank you to Leah Grammatica, Alexa Downing and the whole Lehman Center team for having us.

caption_linkedin:
Thirty years after his debut single, Ginuwine still filled the largest venue in the Bronx.

On Saturday, The Innovators Den covered Ginuwine with special guest Ro James at Lehman Center for the Performing Arts. Three things stood out:

1. Legacy compounds. A song released in 1996 still brought out every age group, dressed up and singing along.
2. Local rooms matter. Lehman Center gives the Bronx major shows without crossing a bridge.
3. Firsts still happen. It was our co-founder Osvaldo "Wally" Rodriguez's first concert ever.

Thank you to Leah Grammatica, Alexa Downing and the Lehman Center team.
